observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a black Samsung monitor by the top edge, showing the front bezel with the Samsung logo at the bottom center. The screen is off. A small blue and green sticker is visible on the top left corner of the bezel.
Photo 1: The same monitor standing upright, front view. The Samsung logo is visible on the bottom bezel. The screen is off. The same sticker is on the top left corner.

Photo 2: The back of the monitor. A vertical label is visible on the right side, with text and symbols, including the Samsung logo. The back panel has a ribbed design and a central cutout for ports. The label appears to have model and serial information, but the text is too small to read clearly in the photo.

read_from: photo 2 label (partially visible, but model name is claimed by seller and consistent with label shape and Samsung branding)

claims.claim: Full HD Business Monitor Samsung Monitor S24E650XL color display unit
claims.evidence: The seller's words state the model, and the Samsung logo is visible in photos 0 and 1. The back label in photo 2 matches the typical placement and appearance of a Samsung monitor label, supporting the brand and model claim.

There is no visual evidence in the photos to confirm the origin or shipping details. The phrase 'Direct Toks' is unclear and likely a typo or misstatement; 'Toks' may mean 'stocks' or 'tokens'. No proof of origin is visible.

risks.proof: A video showing the monitor powered on, displaying a test pattern or moving image, with close-ups of the screen edges and corners, and a shot of the ports on the back being connected to a device.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially defective or non-working

risks.risk: The model may not be S24E650XL; the label in photo 2 is too blurry to read.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the label on the back of the monitor, showing the model number and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown model, which may be lower value

risks.risk: The monitor may be missing accessories such as power cable, stand, or HDMI/VGA cables.

risks.if_unproven: priced as missing accessories, which reduces value

proof_requests: A clear, close-up photo of the label on the back of the monitor showing the model number.
A video of the monitor turned on, displaying a test pattern or moving image, with close-ups of the screen and ports.
A photo showing all included accessories (power cable, stand, cables).
response.reason: The model is claimed and partially supported by the brand logo, but the label is unreadable. The monitor's condition and included accessories are unknown. Without proof of working condition and full accessories, the item cannot be priced accurately. The claim of origin is unverifiable.
